notes: HK depth batch 2. CMHK MySIM retention rule: official PDF (2026-04) confirms recharge extends SIM validity since 2024-12-01; community wiki (prepaid-data-sim-card.fandom.com) documents HK$50+ recharge = +180 days. FX HKD->CNY 0.92.

routes.acquisitionSummary: MySIM 4G costs HK$33 (includes 50GB 30-day local package + 5000 local minutes); sold at 7-Eleven, Circle K and CMHK online shop. Real-name registration required (OFCA rule since 2022-03): passport accepted for foreigners.

keep.action: Official MySIM package terms (PDF 2026-04-15): since 2024-12-01, recharging (any top-up) extends SIM validity — other package purchases no longer do. Community wiki rule: recharge >=HK$50 extends validity 180 days from recharge date; <HK$50 extends 30 days. So retention = 2 x HK$50 top-ups per year = HK$100/yr.

routes.chinaActivation: Activation requires inserting SIM on CMHK network in Hong Kong (official guide: activate in HK); mainland-first activation unverified.
routes.kyc: Real-name registration mandatory (OFCA since 2022-03-01); passport accepted.
routes.payment: Recharge vouchers (HK$30/50/100/200/300) sold in HK stores; online refill via CMHK website/app; Octopus self-service; credit card auto-fill. Overseas card acceptance unverified.
routes.tariffSummary: MySIM HK$33 starter; HK$50 recharge = +180 days validity = HK$100/yr retention.
